bio.text: Victoria Spartz is a member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Indiana who immigrated to the United States from Ukraine in 2000 and became a citizen.
She worked as a CPA and finance executive, served as CFO of the Indiana Attorney General's Office, and was an Indiana State Senator.
She holds degrees from the National University of Economics in Ukraine and a Master of Professional Accountancy from Indiana University, and lives in Noblesville.
